fusions.name: Split Tine
fusions.desc: Flicks a tine that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then branches to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

fusions.name: Two Prongs at Once
fusions.desc: Drives 2 prongs out at once, spread apart. Each deals 11 damage and stuns what it hits for 1 second.

fusions.name: Other Way Round
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Every Other Jab
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 2. At 2 they both spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (54% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
